title.zh: Bybit拓展加密之外业务，可直接交易美国股票和ETF
title.en: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto With Direct Access to U.S. Stocks & ETFs

current_state.zh: Bybit Stocks 已正式上线，符合条件的用户可通过 Bybit 账户以 USDC 交易逾 1000 只美股及 ETF。
current_state.en: Bybit Stocks is now live, letting eligible users trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC from their Bybit accounts.

updates.title_zh: Bybit拓展加密之外业务，可直接交易美国股票和ETF
updates.title_en: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto With Direct Access to U.S. Stocks & ETFs
updates.what_changed_zh: Bybit 宣布将业务拓展至加密货币之外，在其平台上为用户提供直接访问美国股票和 ETF 的服务。
updates.what_changed_en: Bybit announced it is expanding beyond crypto by offering users direct access to U.S. stocks and ETFs on its platform.
updates.current_state_zh: Bybit 宣布将业务拓展至加密货币之外，在其平台上为用户提供直接访问美国股票和 ETF 的服务。
updates.current_state_en: Bybit announced it is expanding beyond crypto by offering users direct access to U.S. stocks and ETFs on its platform.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bybit announced it is expanding beyond crypto by offering users direct access to U.S. stocks and ETFs on its platform.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bybit announced it is expanding beyond crypto by offering users direct access to U.S. stocks and ETFs on its platform.

updates.title_zh: 【Bybit Stocks 正式上线，符合条件用户可交易逾 1000 只美股及 ETF】
updates.title_en: 【Bybit Stocks 正式上线，符合条件用户可交易逾 1000 只美股及 ETF】
updates.what_changed_zh: Bybit Stocks 由此前宣布的扩展计划转为正式上线：符合条件的 KYC 用户在许可地区可用 USDC 交易逾 1000 只美国上市股票及 ETF，支持碎股、24/5 交易、零佣金及公司行动，订单由美国自清算经纪商 Alpaca 执行与托管，服务由受毛里求斯 FSC 监管的 Infra Capital Limited 提供。
updates.what_changed_en: Bybit Stocks moved from an announced expansion plan to a live launch: KYC-verified users in permitted jurisdictions can trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC, with fractional shares, 24/5 trading, zero commission and corporate-action support, executed and custodied by US self-clearing broker Alpaca, with the service provided by Mauritius FSC-regulated Infra Capital Limited.
updates.current_state_zh: Bybit Stocks 已正式上线，符合条件的用户可通过 Bybit 账户以 USDC 交易逾 1000 只美股及 ETF。
updates.current_state_en: Bybit Stocks is now live, letting eligible users trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC from their Bybit accounts.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bybit launched Stocks, letting KYC-verified users in permitted jurisdictions trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC from their Bybit accounts, with 24/5 trading, fractional shares, corporate actions, and execution/custody handled by US broker Alpaca under Infra Capital Limited's Mauritius FSC license.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bybit launched Stocks, letting KYC-verified users in permitted jurisdictions trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC from their Bybit accounts, with 24/5 trading, fractional shares, corporate actions, and execution/custody handled by US broker Alpaca under Infra Capital Limited's Mauritius FSC license.
